integrity: The proof is an unrestricted elementary case split. The semiprime-semiprime branch reduces exactly to the integer equation t(b-a-t)=1, while the prime-semiprime branches reduce to factorizations of 2 or 0. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only Ruth–Aaron pairs with both total prime-factor multiplicities at most two. It does not classify higher multiplicity layers or address the open infinitude problem. The 1974 source predates the exact-day metadata source but was not available here with a verified exact public calendar date.
title: The two-almost-prime boundary for Ruth–Aaron pairs
